page.overview:
What is First Order?

The First Order (21 ABY-35 ABY), or simply the Order, was a fascist neo-Imperialist polity in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. The First Order was a military junta ruled by a Supreme Leader from their mobile headquarters instead of a traditional planetary capital. The First Order sought a return to power and reclaim lost legacy of the Galactic Empire. To this end, it became locked in a Cold War with the New Republic, ending with the First Order staging an invasion of the galaxy, but were repelled by the Resistance and Jedi Order, causing the First Order to fall.

After the death of Darth Sidious, publicly known as Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine, in the Battle of Endor, the Galactic Empire fell following the end of the Galactic Civil War. Spearheaded by Counselor to the Empire Gallius Rax, some of the Imperial Military fled into unknown space during New Republic Era, which the Empire had secretly charted in the past. After blazing through ancient hyperspace trails, retreating Imperial holdouts met secret reinforcements, where Grand Admiral Rae Sloane intended to build a stronger and purer Empire. In the years after, Sloane's remnant forces formed the First Order.

Sloane and Commandant Brendol Hux were among the first leaders of the First Order. The fleets and armies that they secretly built comprised a vast and technologically superior military at the First Order's disposal. The First Order was more critical of the late regime, considering it the major reference point, but surpassed by their greater purity. Through Project Resurrection, the First Order conscripted children—thousands of whom were abducted from outlying star systems—and trained them as the new generation of stormtroopers. The First Order also undertook a major offensive to seize several hermetic kingdoms and their resources in the Unknown Regions. Eventually, the mysterious Snoke rose to power as Supreme Leader, who was in fact an artificial Strand-Cast that served as the proxy the revived Darth Sidious from the hidden world of Exegol. With its original leaders mostly sidelined, the First Order became subservient to the Sith Eternal cult that Sidious controlled and utilised for his plans to turn the First Order into a template for a resurgent Sith Empire. Much of the First Order, however, was unaware of the Sith's influence over their organization.

The First Order was publicly formed by the Centrist-aligned star systems that seceded from the New Republic as a result of instability in the Galactic Senate and refused to comply with the terms of the Galactic Concordance. Throughout the Cold War, the First Order and the New Republic existed in a state of tension with occasional skirmishes but no direct fighting. As the First Order became increasingly hostile toward the New Republic, former Senator Leia Organa founded the Resistance to monitor its activities. However, the Senate refused to take forceful military action against them, believing that they posed no credible threat. The First Order also began to search for Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, to prevent the rise of a new Jedi.
